usedFor: wizishop holds customers and Brevo holds your contact lists, so “Customer Event” can run “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Customer Event” in wizishop, then “Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A changed customer record updates the Brevo contact, so your lists match the shop.

watchOut: “Customer Event” also fires when a customer is deleted, so check what “Update Contact” does on that event.
